---
name: verify-launch-finding
description: Verify accessibility, pointer access and performance findings across scans.
---

Inspect the matching viewport and action. Reuse recorded axe targets, LCP candidates and pointer samples. A hidden duplicate in a closed header cannot establish that a visible action is blocked. Record the positive result on the repaired element. If a target disappears or the state changes, mark comparison inconclusive. Keep an LCP loading attribute separate from any timing claim. Compare repeated performance runs in matched conditions.
